text: User wants a super-brain skill built from the jcode repo with memory, agent delegation, and structured answers

super-brain skill (memory store + UserPromptSubmit/Stop hooks) was built and pushed to branch claude/super-brain-skill-ev8s7g in studentemail0905-create/Claude; hooks confirmed live and firing correctly in-session

Built a production-ready remote MCP server for Medium (medium-mcp-server/) in studentemail0905-create/Claude, pushed to branch claude/medium-mcp-server-fy8f2l (commit 53bca28). Key design: article read via Medium RSS feeds (Medium REST API has no list/get-post endpoint); create_draft for drafts; publishing requires two-step confirm (request_publish_confirmation -> single-use token -> publish_article with acknowledgement="PUBLISH"); read/write/publish toggled independently via env vars; bearer auth for server + Medium integration token; 53 passing vitest tests; Docker/Fly/Render/systemd deploy configs; no PR opened yet (not requested).

medium-mcp-server: this sandboxed remote-execution session cannot reach any external hosting provider (api.fly.io, api.render.com, railway.app, api.vercel.com, api.cloudflare.com, *.onrender.com all return proxy 403 -- confirmed hard egress allowlist limited to GitHub/npm/PyPI/Anthropic). Deployment to Render/Fly/etc must be done by the user manually; Claude cannot call their APIs or curl the resulting URL from this session.

medium-mcp-server deployment decision: Render free web service (no card, ~1min cold start after 15min idle) recommended over Fly.io (lost free tier in 2024, now requires card + billing from day one). Fixed render.yaml bugs: dockerfilePath/dockerContext must be relative to repo root for monorepo (was ./Dockerfile), and MCP_HTTP_PORT must be 10000 to match Render's PORT convention (was 3000) -- pushed as commit a9dc274 on branch claude/medium-mcp-server-fy8f2l.

Claude.ai custom connectors (Customize > Connectors > Add custom connector) support a static bearer token via a beta 'Request headers' section (header name Authorization, value 'Bearer <token>') -- no OAuth server needed for a personal remote MCP server. Fallback if unavailable on an account is MCP_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED=true, which is not recommended.
